posts.title: Attacking GraphQL APIs (OWASP PNW 2024)
posts.description: I spoke at OWASP AppSec Days Pacific Northwest 2024 in Vancouver about attacking GraphQL APIs. The talk covered a range of GraphQL attacks and advanced attack vectors, along with the security considerations that are beyond the traditional checklists. posts.title: Backlog: A Local-First Task and Context Manager for Humans and AI
posts.description: I’ve been working with agentic AI for the past two years, and I kept hitting the same wall: managing the tasks and to-dos it generates. Moving what it learns between sessions. posts.title: The GitHub Breach Through VS Code Is the One I Warned About
posts.description: If you haven’t heard the news, GitHub confirmed unauthorized access to internal repositories through a malicious VS Code extension. I’ve been warning about this. I predicted it would happen in my talk Compromising Developers with Malicious Extensions last December at Black Hat MEA, where I presented several flaws in VS Code and the marketplace and how people can use them to run supply chain attack
